entries.name: Soaked
entries.description: Ground is flooded. Electric hits harder here, fire fizzles.

entries.name: Scorched
entries.description: Embers smoulder underfoot. Grass and ice suffer.

entries.name: Overgrown
entries.description: Tangled growth slows everyone on this side.

entries.name: Frosted
entries.description: Rime coats the ground. Footing is poor.

entries.name: Enchanted
entries.description: Glowing runes ward this side against spells and beams. Cast it on your own side.

entries.name: Hazed
entries.description: A psychic fog dulls every mind on this side.

entries.name: Magnetized
entries.description: Iron filings cling to everything, weighing creatures down and drawing in current.

entries.name: Glitched
entries.description: Corrupted data flickers across this side. Code finds its way in.

entries.name: Haunted
entries.description: Restless spirits whisper here, wearing down the will to resist.

entries.name: Shrouded
entries.description: Thick shadow makes it hard to see what you're aiming at.

entries.name: Radiant
entries.description: Warm light bathes this side, sharpening aim and burning away shadow. Cast it on your own side.
